messages.subject: R1022 QSA native16 XMX feasibility report complete
messages.body: I traced the current long-prefill QSA caller, FP32 query/key producers, inactive SYCL tensor-core hook, and the native16 GEMM shape/output/ownership constraints, then compared packed-GEMM and fused joint-matrix alternatives. The report finds neither candidate currently justified: BF16 score inputs are an approximation pending exact SGLang/vLLM contract validation, and the 15.8 s interval does not isolate scoring from top-k or establish device utilization. Main should first split score-only and top-k timing after its active cohorts; the named report records bounded candidate gates, sources, and evidence limits.
